title: Simplify expressions
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

sections.title: Combine like terms
sections.objective: Add and subtract the x terms together and the numbers together.
explain: Like terms are the same kind of thing: x terms with x terms, plain numbers with plain numbers. 4x + 2x = 6x, the same way 4 apples + 2 apples = 6 apples. But 4x + 3 stays as it is: x's and numbers don't combine.
Each term keeps the sign in front of it. In 5x − 7 − 2x + 3, the terms are 5x, −7, −2x and +3. x terms: 5x − 2x = 3x. Numbers: −7 + 3 = −4. So it's 3x − 4.
x on its own means 1x. So 4x − x = 3x, not 4x. When you type an answer, x on its own is 1 in the first box, and −x is −1.

sections.title: The distributive property
sections.objective: Multiply the number outside the parentheses by every term inside.
explain: 3(x + 4) means 3 groups of (x + 4): (x + 4) + (x + 4) + (x + 4) = 3x + 12. So multiply the 3 by each term inside: 3 × x = 3x and 3 × 4 = 12.
Every term inside gets multiplied, not just the first. 3(x + 4) is 3x + 12, not 3x + 4.
With a negative outside, use the sign rules on each term: −2(x − 5) = −2x + 10, because −2 × −5 = +10. And −(x + 4) means −1 times each term: −x − 4.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Distribute first, then combine like terms.
explain: Now both steps are in one problem. First get rid of the parentheses by distributing; then combine the x terms and the numbers.
4x − 2(x + 3): the minus belongs to the 2, so multiply each term inside by −2: −2x − 6. Then 4x − 2x − 6 = 2x − 6.

misconceptionMessages.alg.expr-sign-dropped: Each term keeps the sign in front of it. A − in front means you subtract that term.
misconceptionMessages.alg.expr-lone-x: x on its own counts as 1x, so it changes the number of x's.
misconceptionMessages.alg.expr-first-only: Multiply the number outside by every term inside the parentheses, not just the first.
misconceptionMessages.alg.expr-second-sign: Use the sign rules on each term: a negative times a negative is positive.
misconceptionMessages.alg.expr-whole-first-only: Distribute to every term inside the parentheses before you combine.
misconceptionMessages.alg.expr-whole-subtract-group: A minus in front of parentheses changes the sign of every term inside, not just the first.
